title: Plans and subscription
summary: JayV has three plans and the plan decides which features you have. Free is the default for anyone without a subscription and is quite limited; Pro brings every function except the organization ones; Enterprise brings everything in Pro plus the organization functions. Pro and Enterprise are subscriptions paid through Stripe.
usage: Open Plans in the sidebar (or Ctrl+K › Plans) to see what each plan includes. Subscribe opens Stripe's payment in the browser and, when it finishes, JayV updates the plan by itself; Manage subscription opens Stripe's portal to change the card or the plan and to cancel. Whoever administers the system builds the plans on the site (Dashboard › Administration › Plans): when you save, each plan becomes a product in Stripe and a paid plan gets its recurring price; changing the amount creates a new price and takes the old one off sale. A plan only goes on sale once it has been sent to Stripe.
